about-me-section.title: About Me
about-me-section.description:
Software Developer focused on Back-End and data management.

I am passionate about understanding how data flows within systems and transforming it into efficient and secure solutions.

Experience in environments with MySQL, Java, C#, Qlik Sense, etc., participating in data migration, integration, and analysis processes.

I stand out for my fast learning ability and for keeping calm in demanding environments. I am looking to keep growing in projects where data and the backend are the core of innovation.

items.descripcion:
**Product Development (Web & Mobile):**
- Participated in the development of a web application for the HR department focused on resume management and processing.
- Mobile application and corporate website development using **Vue.js 3** as main technology.

**Backend Architecture & Database:**
- Designed and managed **MySQL** databases from scratch.
- Implemented **Strapi** as Headless CMS, including custom provider development.

**DevOps & Deployments (CI/CD):**
- Managed application lifecycles maintaining **GitHub** pipelines, orchestrating production releases and infrastructure deployments.

**ETL Design & Implementation**:
 - Developed complex extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes to consolidate and integrate critical fleet, contract, customer, and billing databases.
 **Multiplatform Data Environment Management**:
 - Ensured interoperability and migration of structured data operating with Microsoft SQL Server and DB2 engines.
 **Process Automation**: 
- Designed and implemented process automation using Batch scripts, optimizing workflow by managing secure file movement, compression, and transfer via FTP.

Performed an audit on service performance and system architecture for the client on Qlik. Researched client architecture and service performance, server verification, process flows, conflicts, improvements, etc.
